answer_1.quote: To assess the trustworthiness of LLMs in generating children's stories, we use two open‑source foundation language models, OPT and LLaMA, along with an instruction‑following model Alpaca to generate children's stories.

answer_2.quote: We compare various statistics derived from the text of the generated stories against those of actual stories. Specifically, we use two metrics: sentence length and Flesch reading ease score ... We use Detoxify to identify the presence of toxic text ... We also analyze the data for topic modeling using pyLDAvis.
